## Responsibilities
- Care for patients after a heart attack or cardiac surgery.
- Watch the central monitoring station and act on alarms.
- Teach patients their new medication before they go home.

## Requirements
- French nursing diploma (IDE) and at least 3 years in cardiology or intensive care.
- AFGSU level 2.

## Salary
€35 – 40k / year
